reviews.title: Worked like new
reviews.comment:
Card worked like new for me, no visible imperfections aside from the retail box being opened, no accessories (if there were any to begin with I'm not sure). Card ran cool even in my mini-ITX case at less than 70C under extended 100% load in gaming. Default fan curve noise under full load is somewhat noticeable but not extreme, and since the auto-boost gets to 1950Mhz boost clock at such a good temperature, you could even set a custom fan curve with MSI afterburner and lower the fan curve to make it even more quiet for likely little to no performance hit. That's my experience at least, the Amazon renewed warranty will cover you for a full three months which is ample time to put the card through its paces and test it out. If you decide to do a "buyer's remorse" return (i.e. there is nothing actually wrong with the card) during that window I believe you have to pay for return shipping so like $5 to $10 bucks.
On the other hand you can currently buy the card NEW through Amazon itself (only 30 day return window though), and this would have manufacturer warranty if you decide to keep it. So that's up to you and how long you expect to use it, or if you plan to upgrade to a 3000-series card in the near future maybe you should buy a cheaper used card for now on a local marketplace so you can also resell it for something near the same price in 6 months or whatever.
reviews.author: C.K.

reviews.title: Rough Condition
reviews.comment:
Received it with no packing damage, packaging was good.  Removed the card and rear mount was jacked up pretty bad and the screw mounting hole was elongated.  This was NOT shipping damage.
It would not go into the computer until I adjusted tang near the motherboard.  Clearly it had been bent and deformed with a tool numerous times.  I was expecting it to be near new condition, this wasn't even close but at least it was clean.
But having it that jacked up and ding along with the elongated hole, they should have charged less.
Installed card, and it runs well, bench-tested to specification.  Tried it on a couple video intense games and it worked well.  But the fans kick in really fast so it got noisy.  I worked on the fan curve and turned up my case fan some.  It is much better and only kicks in during intense loads.
Overall it is acceptable and decided to keep it since it does run good.
